correctness.rationale: The exact QLDP parameter is obtained from a uniform spectral sandwich and an explicit attaining antipodal pair. Local-unitary canonicalization reduces the normalized Choi state to Bell-diagonal form, where the entanglement-breaking octahedron and Wootters concurrence formula give C=[s1+s2+s3-1]_+/2. The privacy constraint gives s1<=tanh(epsilon/2), and depolarizing channels have all three singular values equal to this bound, establishing equality.
risks: The bundled finite checker is only a consistency test; the infinite result rests on the analytic proof.
The canonical Bell-diagonal sign-sector reduction is standard unital-qubit channel geometry and was checked against the entanglement-breaking octahedron formulation.

value.rationale: The theorem converts a new sharp but binary entanglement-breaking privacy threshold into an exact resource curve on the full unital-qubit channel class. It identifies the precise maximum Choi concurrence compatible with a privacy budget and proves depolarizing noise is sharp for this entanglement objective, giving an interpretable quantitative continuation above epsilon=log 2.
risks: The scope is deliberately restricted to unital qubit channels; broader nonunital optimization remains open here.
